notes: Children are PkKanbanColumn, each holding PkSortableItem cards. pk-kanban never moves its own children (SDK rule: the host owns the light DOM), so OnMove is the whole contract: handle it by changing your model (remove the card Item from the column From and insert it at ToIndex of the column To) and re-render, keying the cards by their Value so focus stays with the moved card. PkMoveEventArgs has Item, From, To, FromIndex and ToIndex. The event is cancelable in JavaScript; a Blazor handler cannot cancel it, so guard in your model instead.
